candidate_boundary.event: the earliest submit_and_replay tool result whose status is pass and whose certificate program hash matches the submitted canonical program
candidate_boundary.not_formed: generation terminates without such a boundary

censoring.algorithm_or_model_failure: valid outcome when the provider contract remains intact, including request-cap exhaustion without a candidate
censoring.infrastructure_failure: exclude from arm outcome counts and preserve separately, including coordinator interruption, provider-contract mismatch, or terminal provider failure after internal retries

efficiency_signal.comparable_pair: both arms form a certified candidate and both receive Official Pass
efficiency_signal.criterion: at least two of the four median paired D-over-B ratios are at most 0.85, and every defined median ratio is at most 1.15
efficiency_signal.paired_ratio: D-LEDGER value divided by B-FSR value within the same case-replication pair
efficiency_signal.zero_denominator: metric is undefined for that pair and is not imputed

event_counting.interactive_tool_step: one envbench_shell or check_compatibility tool_result; replay and final submission are reported separately
event_counting.model_request: one successful provider_response; failed provider attempts are separately reported
event_counting.through_boundary: request_index less than or equal to the candidate-boundary request_index

mechanism_measurement.candidate_ready_latency: difference in request_index from candidate_ready=true to the next submit_and_replay call, when one exists
mechanism_measurement.complete_observation: check_compatibility result has ok=true and finding_set_complete=true

official_outcome.pass: manifest.result.official_pass is true after completed official evaluation

resource_extraction.model_tokens: sum provider response usage through the boundary, retaining prompt, completion, reasoning, total, cache, and cost fields separately
resource_extraction.time: certificate.certified_at minus solver.metadata.started_at; total generation and official evaluation time are additional outcomes
resource_extraction.treatment_measurement_cost: compatibility-check tool steps, hidden goal executions, and subsequent context tokens remain charged to D-LEDGER

validity_checks: recorded request provider order equals [deepinfra] for every provider response
returned provider is DeepInfra for every provider response
image digest and goal-contract hash match across arms
repository integrity audit is valid whenever generation completes
